title_zh: 在第一个标记之前：通过预生成状态模式来表征情感模态冲突

topics: 脑电情感计算与脑机接口；情感理解与情感智能；情感计算与情绪理解；多模态与大语言模型
abstract_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）越来越多地被部署在情感敏感的交互中，例如心理健康支持。当视觉、文本和音频线索不一致时，模型可能会基于肤浅的线索形成片面的理解，从而导致对用户情绪状态的误解。本文研究了最后一个条件标记的多模态情感冲突的内部表征，以及生成前状态与随后的情感误读之间的关系。我们提取单峰和联合输入的全层轨迹，通过轨迹流形编码器学习状态表示，并计算状态索引以...
abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly being deployed in emotion-sensitive interactions such as mental health support. When visual, textual, and audio cues are inconsistent, models may form a one-sided understanding based on superficial cues, leading to a misinterpretation of the user's emotional state. This paper investigates the internal representations of multimodal affective conflicts at the last conditioning token, as well as the relationship between pre-generation states and subsequent affective misreads. We extract the full-layer trajectories of unimodal and joint inputs, learn state representations via a Trajectory Manifold Encoder, and calculate state indices to identify state patterns. Experimental results demonstrate that conflicting samples and aligned samples exhibit distinguishable state structures, which correlate with affective misreads. The trajectory manifold representations outperform baselines in terms of representation quality, cross-domain transferability, and performance under limited conflict supervision. The State-Guided Response reduces affective response errors and enhances overall response quality. This paper provides an early, interpretable analytical approach to understanding the relationship between multimodal affective conflicts and misreads.

title_en: Multiple Feature Analysis for Infrared Small Target Detection

abstract_zh: 小目标检测一直是红外系统中一项重要且具有挑战性的任务。大多数仅使用单一度量的检测算法很难将目标与杂波完全分离。当存在复杂背景时，误报可能会较高。在这封信中，从四个方面提出了多个新颖的特征来建立详细的描述。每个特征都反映了小目标的具体特征。选择最佳特征向量来应用这些特征进行检测。然后，训练基于学习的分类器来筛选通过初始分割获得的候选目标。实验结果表明，所提出的特征可以从各种杂波效应中区分出小目标。
abstract_en: Detection of small target has been an important and challenging task in infrared systems. Most detection algorithms which only use single metric are difficult to separate target from clutter completely. The false alarm may be high when there exists complex backgrounds. In this letter, multiple novel features are proposed from four aspects to establish elaborate description. Each feature reflects specific characteristic of small target. The best feature vector is selected to apply these features for detection. Then, learning-based classifier is trained to screen candidate targets which are obtained by initial segmentation. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed features could discriminate small targets from various clutters effectively. The better detection performance is achieved compared with other methods in different infrared backgrounds.

abstract_zh: 非均匀噪声是成像系统需要解决的关键问题之一。由于各探测器的不均匀性，图像中存在规则的条状噪声，严重影响图像质量进而影响图像应用。在目标识别系统中，除了各图像之间的均匀性之外，序列图像中的相邻图像之间还存在强度差异。本文提出了一种基于局部直方图规范的序列图像非均匀性校正新方法。该过程的目的是抑制不均匀噪声并平滑图像。两个相邻的图像逐列交错成一个图像。然后，对图像进行局部加权处理...
abstract_en: Non-uniformity noise is one of the critical problems that need to be solved in imaging system. Due to the non-uniform of each detector, there are regular strip noises in the image, which has serious effect on the image quality and thus on image applications. In target recognition system, there is also intensity difference between the adjacent images in the sequencial images other than the uniformity between each image. In this paper, a new non-uniformity correction method for sequence-image based on local histogram specification is proposed. The process is aimed to suppress the non-uniformity noise and smooth the image. The two adjacent images are interlaced into one image column by column. And then, the image is processed by the local weight histogram specification method . Experimental results show that the method presented in this paper can effectively suppress the strip noise in each image and thus reduce the gray level difference among the image sequences.

abstract_zh: 提出一种基于时空过采样和自适应滤波的点目标增强方法。首先，设计了用于目标成像增强的过采样扫描成像系统。两个单独的探测器阵列在交叉扫描方向上彼此偏移半探测器，并且在扫描内方向上的采样频率增加。将两个探测器阵列的两帧图像交错组合得到点目标的亚像素图像。其次，利用图像滤波来增强杂波背景中嵌入的目标。执行杂波背景抑制、局部增强和对比度扩展。实验结果表明本文提出的方法...
abstract_en: A method for point target enhancement based on temporal-spatial over-sampling and adaptive filtering is proposed in this paper. First of all, an over-sampling scanning imaging system is designed for target imaging enhancement. Two separate detector arrays are offset to each other by a half detector in the cross-scan direction and the sampling frequency in the in-scan direction is increased. A sub-pixel image of point target is obtained by interlace-combined two frame image from the two detector arrays. Secondly, image filtering is used to enhance the target embedded in clutter background. Clutter background suppression, local enhancement and contrast extension are performed. Experimental results show that the method presented in this paper can enhance the point target effectively in scanning detection system.

abstract_zh: 地面目标检测对于精确红外成像制导至关重要。为了解决这个问题，提出了一种对关键点（即建筑物顶点）进行精确跟踪的算法。首先，通过Kanade-Lucas-Tomasi（KLT）算法提取特征点，并且在跟踪过程中根据偏移量不断更新特征点模板。然后根据提取的特征点，利用特征点与关键点之间的几何关系来定位关键点。第三，算法跟踪特征点，利用几何关系来跟踪下一帧的关键点。实验结果证明了该算法在跟踪 k 方面的有效性...
abstract_en: Ground target detection is very important in precise infrared imaging guidance. To address this problem, an accurate tracking algorithm of the key points, i.e., vertex of buildings is proposed. First, the feature points are extracted by Kanade-Lucas-Tomasi (KLT) algorithm, and the template of feature points is updated constantly in the tracking process according to the offset. Then based on the extracted feature points, the key point can be positioned using the geometric relation between the feature points and the key point. Third, the algorithm tracks the feature points and uses the geometric relation to track the key point in the next frame. The experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm in tracking the key point of buildings in front-lower infrared image sequences for long time precise guidance.

abstract_zh: 目标检测、分割与识别是当今图像处理和模式识别领域的研究热点，其中显着区域或目标检测是精确制导武器的核心技术之一。本文提出了许多理论；我们利用经典的特征整合理论和 Itti 的视觉注意系统来检测一系列输入红外图像中的显着物体。为了准确地找到图像中的显着对象，我们提出了一种通过计算和使用边缘掩模来解决边缘模糊问题的新方法。我们还通过改进中心-环绕差异法大大提高了计算速度。与传统算法不同，我们计算center-surrou...
abstract_en: Target detection, segmentation and recognition is a hot research topic in the field of image processing and pattern recognition nowadays, among which salient area or object detection is one of core technologies of precision guided weapon. Many theories have been raised in this paper; we detect salient objects in a series of input infrared images by using the classical feature integration theory and Itti’s visual attention system. In order to find the salient object in an image accurately, we present a new method to solve the edge blur problem by calculating and using the edge mask. We also greatly improve the computing speed by improving the center-surround differences method. Unlike the traditional algorithm, we calculate the center-surround differences through rows and columns separately. Experimental results show that our method is effective in detecting salient object accurately and rapidly.

title_en: Ship detection based on spatial partial features

abstract_zh: 本文主要研究如何从船载红外图像中检测出多种船舶，以实施海上监测。不同类型的船舶在外观上有显着差异。传统的利用物体全局纹理特征的检测方法不适合检测各种船舶。本文提出了一种新颖的检测算法，该算法提取由 Adaboost 训练的空间部分纹理特征来建立用于检测的船舶模型。我们首先通过随机遍历提取物体的所有部分区域，然后使用“Uniform LBP”算子提取纹理特征。与传统方式相比，我们将每个部分特征单独保存为一个特征向量......
abstract_en: This paper mainly studies how to detect a wide variety of ships from the ship-borne infrared images in order to implement sea monitoring. Different types of ships have significant differences in their appearance. The traditional detection method which uses the global texture features of the object is not suitable to detect varied ships. This paper presents a novel detection algorithm which extracts spatial partial texture features trained by Adaboost to establish the ship model for detection. We first extract all the partial regions of the object through random traversal, and then extract the texture features by using the “Uniform LBP” operator. Compared to the traditional way, we save each partial feature individually as one feature vector, which not only reduces the vector dimension but also highlights the key regions when the partial regions with strong generality are selected by Adaboost at the second step. Finally, the selected partial features are boosted with weights to establish ship model for the ship detection. The proposed approach is efficient and robust in the infrared ship detection.

abstract_zh: 文档图像中的数字提取是文档图像分析中的一项关键技术。为了简单有效地提取数字，本文提出了一种基于数学形态学的算法。首先，使用设计的结构元素通过形态膨胀运算来标记包含数字的正方形区域。其次，通过形态学侵蚀操作提取正方形区域。第三，通过形态膨胀操作提取正方形区域的内部区域。最后，通过将提取的正方形区域与原始的正方形区域内部区域进行比较来提取数字。实验结果表明该算法是有效的。
abstract_en: Number extraction in document image is a crucial technique in document image analysis. To simply and efficiently extract the numbers, a mathematical morphology based algorithm is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the square regions containing numbers are labeled by morphological dilation operation using a designed structuring element. Secondly, the square regions are extracted by morphological erosion operation. Thirdly, the inner region of the square regions is extracted through morphological dilation operations. Finally, the numbers are extracted through comparing the extracted and original inner region of the square regions. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm is efficient.

abstract_zh: 由于红外图像的信噪比极低，红外图像序列中的目标跟踪是一个具有挑战性的研究课题。本文提出了一种基于多线索融合粒子滤波器框架的新跟踪方法。为了充分利用物体的外观信息，物体建模时既考虑了物体的空间分布，又考虑了物体的灰度分布。同时，使用仿射变换模型来估计集成在跟踪框架中的对象的运动。首先，利用运动信息来表示每个粒子的状态。其次，每个对象由彼此独立的强度模板和灰度直方图建模。其重量...
abstract_en: Object tracking in infrared image sequences is a challenging research topic due to the extremely low signal to noise ratio of IR image. In this paper, a new tracking method based on multiple cues fusion particle filter framework is proposed. In order to make full use of the object appearance information, both the spatial distribution and the gray distribution of the object are considered in object modeling. Meanwhile, an affine transform model is used to estimate the motion of the object which is integrated in the tracking framework. Firstly, the motion information is used to represent the state of each particle. Secondly, each object is modeled by intensity template and gray histogram which are independent to each other. The weights of the particles are obtained through the similarity of each feature model. Finally, to overcome the problems relating to the changes in the object appearance, the object model is dynamically updated according to the tracking result using kernel density estimation. It uses the complementarities of the two features to improve the reliability in tracking task. The experimental results show that the fusion of multiple cues makes the tracking performance effective in infrared images.

abstract_zh: 提出一种基于多尺度数学形态学和目标增强的分水岭变换红外目标分割算法。首先，采用多尺度数学形态学算子对原始红外图像进行预处理，抑制噪声的影响，保护目标。其次，利用红外图像的特性、非参数核方法和线性扩展对弱小目标进行增强。第三，对增强后的目标区域的部分像素进行二值化，然后通过形态学算子进行处理，作为红外目标的标记。最后，利用Sobel检测器计算出预处理后的红外图像的梯度后，进行分水岭……
abstract_en: A new infrared target segmentation algorithm by using watershed transform based on multi-scale mathematical morphology and target enhancement is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the multi-scale mathematical morphological operator is used to pre-process the original infrared image, which suppresses the effect of noises and protects targets. Secondly, the property of the infrared image, non-parameter kernel method and linear extension are used to enhance dim target. Thirdly, some pixels of the enhanced target regions are binarized and then processed by morphological operators as the markers of the infrared targets. Finally, after the gradient of the pre-processed infrared image is calculated by using Sobel detector, the watershed is performed on the gradient image guided by the markers of target regions to segment the target regions. The proposed method can be widely used in different applications of target detection, target tracking, navigation system and so on. Experimental results verify that the proposed method is efficient.

title_zh: 机载视频中的移动车辆检测
title_en: Moving Vehicles Detection in Airborne Video
venue: International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
primary_category: 情感理解与多模态推理
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种机载视频中运动车辆检测方法。为了处理非静止背景下的运动目标检测，根据Harris特征点提取算法提取的对应控制点逐帧估计背景的全局运动。利用特征点的相对位置来去除不合适的点对。利用仿射变换模型，进行背景补偿处理。相邻帧对齐以保持静止的背景。应用统计背景建模来估计背景图像，并使用背景减法来检测移动物体。此外，运动斑点掩模是从帧差异获得的......
abstract_en: A method to detect moving vehicles in airborne video is proposed in this paper. In order to deal with moving object detection in non-stationary background, the global motion of background is estimated frame by frame according to the correspondence control points extracted by Harris feature point extraction algorithm. The relative position of the feature points is used to remove the inadequate point pairs. With an affine transformation model, the background compensation is processed. Neighboring frames are aligned to maintain a stationary background. A statistical background modeling is applied to estimate background image and background subtraction is used to detect moving objects. Besides, a motion blobs mask is obtained from frame difference and detection results to update only areas of non moving objects in the background model. Experimental results show that the approach is able to obtain a robust detection result in airborne video.

title_zh: 基于标记的分水岭通过图像增强分割昏暗的红外目标

abstract_zh: 提出了一种通过图像增强的基于标记的新型分水岭来分割昏暗的红外目标。首先通过CB顶帽变换和图像量化对弱红外目标进行增强。然后，通过图像二值化和标记过滤可以轻松获得目标的准确标记。为了计算用于分水岭分割的暗目标的有效梯度图像，首先通过Sobel算子计算梯度图像，然后通过伪顶帽变换和梯度量化来有效增强。由于弱目标和梯度图像的增强，分水岭可以有效分割弱红外图像。实验结果表明，该算法...
abstract_en: A novel marker based watershed through image enhancement is proposed to segment the dim infrared target. The dim infrared target is firstly enhanced by CB top-hat transformation and image quantization. Then, the accurate marker of the target can be easily obtained through image binarisation and marker filtering. To calculate an efficient gradient image of the dim target for the watershed segmentation, the gradient image is firstly calculated through Sobel operator and then efficiently enhanced through pseudo top-hat transformation and gradient quantization. Because of the enhancement of the dim target and the gradient image, the watershed can efficiently segment the dim infrared image. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm is much efficient for dim infrared target segmentation.

title_zh: 基于轮廓结构元的改进顶帽变换红外小目标检测
title_en: Modified top-hat transformation based on contour structuring element to detect infrared small target
venue: IEEE Conference on Industrial Electronics and Applications (ICIEA)
primary_category: 情感理解与多模态推理
abstract_zh: 顶帽变换已广泛应用于红外小目标检测，但其对杂波敏感，可能会破坏图像的细节，这使其成为小目标检测的无效方法。为了简单、高效地检测红外小目标，本文提出一种基于轮廓结构元的新Top-hat变换，并根据目标区域的性质进行修改，以增强和检测红外小目标。实验结果表明，该方法在强杂波和弱目标强度的条件下是有效的。
abstract_en: Top-hat transformation has been widely used for infrared small target detection, but it is sensitive to the clutter and may destroy the details of the image, which make it an ineffective way for small target detection. To detect the infrared small target simply and efficiently, a new Top-hat transformation based on contour structuring element is proposed and then modified according to the property of the target region to enhance and detect the infrared small target in this paper. Experimental results indicated that the proposed method was efficient under the conditions of heavy clutter and dim target intensity.

title_zh: 自适应形态学杂波消除方法增强和检测红外小目标
title_en: Adaptive Morphological Method for Clutter Elimination to Enhance and Detect Infrared Small Target
venue: International Conference on Internet Computing for Science and Engineering
primary_category: 情感理解与多模态推理
abstract_zh: 为了克服重杂波和弱目标强度对小目标检测的影响，提出了一种高效的杂波消除形态学方法。所提出的自适应方法将目标区域的属性引入到形态学运算中，这明显提高了方法的性能，并且可以很大程度上增强暗淡的小目标。因此，通过一种基于自适应形态学杂波消除方法的目标检测算法可以很容易地检测到目标。实验表明，该方法能够准确消除杂波背景，从而大幅增强并有效检测小目标。
abstract_en: To overcome the affection of heavy clutter and dim target intensity on small target detection, an efficient morphological method through clutter elimination is proposed. The proposed adaptive method imports the property of the target region into the morphological operations, which apparently improves the performance of the method and can largely enhance the dim small target. So, the target can be easily detected through a target detection algorithm, which is proposed based on the adaptive morphological method for clutter elimination. Experiments show that the proposed method can accurately eliminate the clutter background, and thus largely enhance and efficiently detect the small target.

title_zh: 目标强度弱、杂波背景条件下的红外小目标检测与跟踪
title_en: Infrared small target detection and tracking under the conditions of dim target intensity and clutter background
venue: Proceedings of SPIE, the International Society for Optical Engineering/Proceedings of SPIE
primary_category: 情感理解与多模态推理
abstract_zh: 为了降低弱目标强度和强杂波对红外小目标检测与跟踪的影响，提出一种新的算法。该算法首先引入小目标区域的特性，提出了改进的顶帽变换，大大增强了弱目标，明显抑制了重杂波。因此，潜在目标很容易通过迭代阈值方法进行分割。通过膨胀累加减少误报后，利用真实目标的运动特性形成的数据关联，正确给出真实目标和轨迹。各种实验验证了所提出的算法是高效且鲁棒的......
abstract_en: To reduce the influences of the dim target intensity and heavy clutter on infrared small target detection and tracking, a novel algorithm is presented in this paper. The algorithm proposes a modified top-hat transformation by importing the property of the small target region firstly, which largely enhances the dim target and apparently suppresses the heavy clutter. Consequently, the potential targets are easy to be segmented by the iterative thresholding method. After decreasing the false alarms through the dilation cumulation, the real target and the trajectory are correctly given by using the data association formed by the motion property of the real target. Various experiments verified that the proposed algorithm was efficient and robust for dim target detection and tracking under the condition of heavy clutter.
